document.title: Auto-reply to comment in DM

source.description_exact: Send a product lineup in Instagram DMs
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Auto-reply to comment in DM
Business value
You’ve got products. Like, a lot of products. They could be digital or affiliate products, free resources, or your new line of scented sculpting clay… Now you just gotta get them in front of your followers in as many places as possible (and make some sales). Think: Less promoting, more purchasing.
How does it work?

You can earn real money from Instagram as easy as a comment, and show off the products you have in a cool little product gallery. You’ll give your followers what they want, and show ‘em what else you’ve got to offer — right in their DM inbox.

json_exact.default_basis: Saved clone state after reload discarded unsaved Next Post or Reel variant; active DOM class independently captured.

json_exact.residual: Enabling created an empty Actions step in the owned draft. Disabled the button association; did not delete the residual step.

json_exact.detail: Switching back cleared the keyword. Restored the captured literal keyword before Continue; empty keywords disable Continue.

before: Details sent! Look in your DMs 📩

selection.choose_when: Use an opening private reply, a button-confirmed product link and a 60-second inline follow-up.
selection.avoid_when: Do not confuse the inline delay with a verified no-click condition.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
